summary: DataMeds AI, Inc. (formerly Wellgistics Health) filed an 8-K disclosing an Amended and Restated Letter of Intent with EOS, Scilex, Datavault, and HealthBridge Advisors. The transaction involves acquiring or exclusively licensing QOLPOM-related IP from EOS and Scilex, expanding PharmacyChain license with Datavault to include Datavault AI Health, and acquiring a controlling interest in Tollo Health via membership interest exchange. Consideration is entirely common stock with no preferred or convertible securities. Post-closing, EOS, Scilex, Datavault, and HBA would own approximately 84.6% combined, Fortitude ~5%, and existing public stockholders ~10.4%, subject to capitalization model adjustments and liability reduction/financing transactions. Definitive agreements remain to be negotiated. Watch for final deal terms, regulatory approvals, and potential stock dilution impact on existing shareholders.
